summary: The Heydar Aliyev International Education Grant is a scholarship of the Government of Azerbaijan, run by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of Science and Education. It was set up by a presidential decree of 8 July 2023 and offers 100 places a year to international students, offered annually for a period of 5 years starting with 2026-2027. It supports full-time study at preparatory, bachelor's (including general medicine), master's (including medical residency) and doctoral level at universities in Azerbaijan. Candidates must first be nominated by an authority in their own country.
eligibility_notes:
Citizens of these country groups may take part: member states of the Organization of Islamic Cooperation, member states of the Non-Aligned Movement, Small Island Developing States, and countries that share common cultural, ethnic and historical ties with Azerbaijan. The call refers to a list of eligible countries in an annex that was not in the file read, so no country list is given here.

Citizens of Azerbaijan, and people whose Azerbaijani citizenship has been terminated, are not considered.

Application is in two stages. First the applicant submits the nomination form and documents to the relevant authority of their own country (a ministry, an embassy and so on). Only candidates officially nominated by their country go on to apply in the SIACAS admission portal. Nomination does not guarantee the grant. A person with several nationalities may submit one application only, under one eligible nationality as nominated by the relevant state bodies.

Academic results: the marks of every previous degree or school stage (general secondary education, bachelor's, general medicine, master's, medical residency) must be at least 70 on a 0 to 100 scale, or 7 on a 10 scale, or equivalent.

Language: for study in English, IELTS 5 (TOEFL 40) for undergraduate and IELTS 5.5 (TOEFL 50) for postgraduate programmes, or previous education in English. For Russian or Turkish, proof of proficiency or previous education in that language. For Azerbaijani, proof of English, Russian or Turkish, or previous education in one of those. The university may test the candidate's level and language.

Study is full-time. The Selection Committee may check the information given at any time.
age_experience_notes: Age limits as of 15.09.2026: below 35 for undergraduate and general medicine; below 40 for master's and medical residency; below 45 for doctoral programmes. No work experience requirement is stated.
funding_summary: The grant pays tuition and language preparatory courses for the study period, one economy-class flight to Baku and back each year, a monthly allowance of 800 AZN (470 USD) for 10 months a year (not July and August), a yearly medical allowance of 200 AZN (117 USD), and a single-entry visa with a temporary residence permit for each academic year. Payments apply only for the standard length of each programme, and amounts are paid in manat at the Central Bank rate on the day of payment. Any expense not named in the call is not covered or reimbursed.
programmes_note: Levels and durations given by the call: preparatory courses 6 months to 1 year (set by the university); bachelor's 4 to 5 years; general medicine 5 to 6 years; master's 1.5 to 2 years; medical residency 2 to 5 years; doctoral (PhD) 3 years. Durations follow the approved programme of each specialty. Languages of study named: English, Russian, Turkish and Azerbaijani. The call lists a separate annex of programmes that was not in the file read, so no programme names are given.
institutions_note: Candidates choose 3 specialties at different higher education institutions of Azerbaijan in the SIACAS portal under the Heydar Aliyev - International Education Grant channel. A separate annex lists participating institutions and was not available in the file read.

summary.detail: Preparatory courses (including language preparatory courses in line with the language of instruction), 6 months to 1 year, length set by the higher education institution. For medical programmes the start date may differ.
summary.source_text: Duration of preparatory courses range from 6 months to 1 year

summary.detail: Bachelor's 4 to 5 years; general medicine 5 to 6 years (set by each specialty's approved programme). Applicants must be below 35 on 15.09.2026. English-taught: IELTS 5 (TOEFL 40).
Master's 1.5 to 2 years; medical residency 2 to 5 years. Applicants must be below 40 on 15.09.2026. English-taught: IELTS 5.5 (TOEFL 50).
Doctoral (PhD) 3 years. Applicants must be below 45 on 15.09.2026. English-taught: IELTS 5.5 (TOEFL 50) for postgraduate programmes.

benefits.limit_text: Tuition fee and language preparatory courses (matching the language of instruction) for the study period
benefits.conditions: Stated for undergraduate, graduate, general medicine, medical residency and doctoral levels. Payments apply only for the length of each programme.

benefits.limit_text: One international economy-class flight ticket to Baku from the country of origin, and one back, once a year
benefits.conditions: Once a year, for the length of the programme

benefits.limit_text: 800 AZN (470 USD) per month for accommodation, daily expenses and educational materials
benefits.conditions: 10 months each year, except July and August; paid in manat at the Central Bank rate on the day of payment

benefits.limit_text: Yearly allowance of 200 AZN (117 USD) for medical care and medication during study in Azerbaijan
benefits.conditions: A yearly allowance, not an insurance policy; paid in manat at the Central Bank rate on the day of payment

benefits.limit_text: Single-entry visa to Azerbaijan and a temporary residence permit for each academic year
Any expense not specified in the call is not covered or reimbursed

requirements.text: Completed nomination form (first stage, submitted to the relevant authority of the applicant's country).
Copies of diplomas and transcripts from prior high school or higher education. Marks of each previous degree or school stage must be at least 70/100, 7/10 or equivalent.

Copy of a medical certificate including HIV/AIDS and Hepatitis B and C tests, from a clinic in the country of residence, dated no more than 3 months before the application, confirming good health for travel and study.
Copy of a valid passport confirming identity details.

Proof of proficiency in the language of study, or previous education in that language. English: IELTS 5 (TOEFL 40) undergraduate, IELTS 5.5 (TOEFL 50) postgraduate. Azerbaijani study: proof of English, Russian or Turkish, or previous education in one of them.
Local and international awards, if available.

Format rules: documents must be clear and legible, in Azerbaijani, Turkish, English or Russian and notarised; other languages need a notarised English translation (a medical certificate in another language needs a certified translation); all in PDF format and uploaded in the portal before the deadline.

application_steps.title: Submit the nomination form to your own government authority
application_steps.detail: Hand in the nomination form and the required documents to the relevant authority of your country (a ministry, embassy or similar). The first-stage window was 16 February to 15 April 2026, closing at 6 PM Baku time on 15 April.

application_steps.title: Wait for national review and nomination
application_steps.detail: The national authorities review and evaluate candidates (16 April to 1 June 2026). Authorities contact the shortlisted applicants so that they can register in the SIACAS portal. Only nominated applications are evaluated for the scholarship.

application_steps.title: Register in the SIACAS portal and choose three specialties
application_steps.detail: Nominated candidates register in the Study in Azerbaijan Centralized Admission Service from 1 June (12 AM) to 10 June 2026, 6 PM Baku time, choose the Heydar Aliyev - International Education Grant channel, and select 3 specialties at different universities. All documents are uploaded before the deadline. Status and notifications appear in the applicant's personal account.

application_steps.title: Review by the Selection Committee
application_steps.detail: Candidates were reviewed and evaluated from 10 June to 1 July 2026. The final decision belongs only to the Selection Committee and decisions are final and cannot be appealed. The Selection Committee can verify the information at any time. The call describes no test or interview, but the university may check language and level.

application_steps.title: Notification and confirmation
application_steps.detail: Selected candidates were notified from 1 July to 1 August 2026 by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and through SIACAS. A selected applicant who does not confirm participation in SIACAS by the set deadline may lose the place to another applicant.

application_steps.title: Formalise the grant and sign the agreement
application_steps.detail: The selected applicant receives instructions to formalise the grant; no reply within the set time may cancel it. A person counts as a scholarship recipient only after delivering the required documents to the university offices in Azerbaijan, and must follow the grant agreement signed with the university and keep in touch with the departments assigned during the scholarship.

application_steps.title: Arrive for the academic year
application_steps.detail: The academic year starts on 15 September 2026 (it may differ for preparatory courses for medical programmes) and the last date to arrive in Azerbaijan is 30 September 2026. Selected applicants receive a guide on their stay, rights and obligations, visa and migration rules.
